subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about reactivating lapsed subscribers for {Brand}. The language-learning market is now tracking from $6.7B in 2026 to $24.37B by 2035, so every player from Babbel down is buying into a more crowded paywall. That matters because education runs about 10.9% install-to-trial and 25.6% trial-to-paid, meaning most installs never reach a paid subscription and the cheapest renewal left is the lapsed learner you already taught. We measure recovery against a randomized holdout so paid reactivations show as incremental to organic resubscribes. Worth comparing against your current win-back mix?
angle: fresh angle: language-learning market expansion to $24.37B by 2035 (sourced) + education install-to-trial/trial-to-paid benchmark band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN education retargeting: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (language-learning market $6.7B 2026 to $24.37B 2035, web-verified Business Research Insights) + education benchmark band (10.9% install-to-trial, 25.6% trial-to-paid, web-verified Adapty); peer Babbel reused from parent (no new brands); MobUpps randomized-holdout incrementality referenced with no figure (no illustrative flag this stage); 1 question mark; no sign-off; market context sourced, never attributed to MobUpps; no X-not-Y.
